MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card fits my repeated purchases of memory cards and gives me spare storage for compatible devices.",
    "Including an adapter makes the card useful alongside the card reader I bought, so it connects to how I already manage storage."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire tablet adds little when I already have a Fire 7 and have shown no current need to replace it or get a larger screen.",
    "Owning a TV and DVD player does not mean I want streaming equipment; the 4K stick's resolution also offers little for my listed 720p TV.",
    "The Echo devices and Bluetooth speaker do not address the practical storage, charging, mounting, and camera-accessory needs reflected in my purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a whole range of Amazon devices, although it does not establish a need for Alexa or smart speakers.",
    "My TV purchase seems to have been treated as ongoing interest in entertainment upgrades, without a clear reason for me to add streaming equipment now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that help equipment I already own work better, such as cables, mounts, memory cards, and storage cases.",
    "Repeated memory-card purchases suggest an ongoing need for spare storage, while owning a tablet alone gives much less reason to recommend another tablet.",
    "My latest purchase was a camera lens cap, which makes practical camera accessories more relevant than an assumed move toward smart-home devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The storage card matches a recurring practical need, but most of the list turns device ownership into an unsupported desire for more entertainment and Alexa devices."
}
